title: Emergence of Visible Light in a 3D Jammed Lattice (SOC + MST Option–B unit realisation)
description: Code + data bundle for a 3D jammed lattice model with SOC percolation pinning, MST Option–B unit realisation (633 nm operational anchor), RCROSS(532 nm) check, and a sparse-sampled visible carrier (633/532 nm) wave demonstration. Includes pre-registered thresholds (YAML) and SHA256 manifest for auditability.
